Job Description




We are looking for a GenAI Agent Engineer to build autonomous AI workflows, multi-agent systems, and specialized RAG pipelines for complex enterprise compliance and content systems.

In this role, you will focus on building high-reliability agent logic, prompt orchestration, and context management centered around the Claude API and Anthropic Agent SDK ecosystem. You will design supervisor-agent patterns, human-in-the-loop validation flows, and RAG architectures that strictly enforce brand guidelines and regulatory compliance.




Key Responsibilities



Architect and implement multi-agent workflows, context memory management, and structured output handling using Python and Claude API/SDK.
Design autonomous agents (Campaign Intake, Content Generation, Brand Governance, and Compliance Validation).
Build robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines utilizing Azure AI Search for deep knowledge base indexing.
Integrate AI workflows with core REST APIs, Webhooks, and internal tools (e.g., Monday.com, Adobe Experience Cloud stack).
Implement Human-in-the-loop evaluation and rule-based validation logic to monitor model outputs for brand consistency and regulatory alignment.
